en.headline: Victoria Park Mid-Autumn lantern carnival opens with international displays
en.dek: The LCSD carnival and the Tourism Board’s first International Lantern Spectacular run from 17 to 27 September, featuring thousands of lanterns including an eight-metre banyan installation.
body: Victoria Park in Causeway Bay lit up on Thursday evening as the Mid-Autumn Lantern Carnival and the Hong Kong Tourism Board’s inaugural International Lantern Spectacular began a 11-day run.

The Leisure and Cultural Services Department carnival, held on soccer pitches 1 to 6, features lantern displays themed around Hong Kong’s everyday life and local food. Highlight installations include shapes of egg waffles, milk tea, curry fish balls, egg tarts, wonton noodles and dim sum, as well as floral and heritage lanterns made by traditional craftsmen.

The Tourism Board’s parallel International Lantern Spectacular brings more than 3,000 lanterns from 20 countries and regions, together with giant Qinhuai lanterns from Nanjing recognised as national intangible cultural heritage. The centrepiece is an eight-metre banyan-tree installation named Shadowlight, the first time Nanjing artisans have used a Hong Kong banyan as the subject of a large main lantern.

Lighting hours are 6.30pm to 11pm daily, extended to midnight on 25 September, the Mid-Autumn Festival itself. Admission is free on a first-come, first-served basis, with crowd control measures if needed. Organisers encourage visitors to come on days other than the festival day itself to avoid peak crowds.
A Mid-Autumn creative market runs on weekends, and a mooncake sale in partnership with Po Leung Kuk is scheduled for the first few days. The programme forms part of the Chinese Culture Festival.

zh.headline: 維園中秋綵燈會開幕 首辦國際綵燈匯展出逾三千盞燈
zh.dek: 康文署綵燈會及旅發局國際中秋綵燈匯由9月17日至27日舉行，亮點包括八米高榕樹綵燈及港式美食造型燈飾。
body: 銅鑼灣維多利亞公園周四晚亮起綵燈，丙午年中秋綵燈會及香港旅遊發展局首辦的國際中秋綵燈匯同步展開，為期11日。
康文署綵燈會於一號至六號足球場舉行，設計以香港地道風情及美食為主題。亮點包括雞蛋仔、港式奶茶、咖喱魚蛋、蛋撻、雲吞麵及點心等造型綵燈，以及由傳統紮作師傅製作的非遺元素花燈。
旅發局的國際中秋綵燈匯則匯集來自20個國家及地區逾三千盞特色綵燈，以及南京秦淮大型綵燈。壓軸是八米高的《樹影流光》榕樹裝置，是南京工匠首次以香港大榕樹為主體創作大型綵燈。
綵燈亮燈時間為每晚6時30分至11時，中秋正日（9月25日）延長至午夜12時。免費入場，先到先得，人多時會實施人流管制。主辦單位呼籲市民盡量選擇正日以外日子前往，以免過於擠擁。
周末設有中秋創意市集，首數天亦有與保良局合作的月餅義賣。活動屬中華文化節節目之一。
